# Security and Price Correctness Checklist: Database Schema

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of access, privacy and price derivation before planning
**Created**: 2026-10-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `checklist` procedure based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Access Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is read and write access defined for every entity in Key Entities, including admin log and profile? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021 to FR-027]
- [ ] CHK002 Is it specified who may create a profile and who may change the admin flag? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK003 Is it specified whether a user may edit or withdraw their own pending submission? [Gap, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the fields a user may set on a submission limited, so a user cannot set status or submitter? [Gap, Spec §FR-016]

## Privacy

- [ ] CHK005 Is it explicit that current prices and live baselines and overrides expose no submitter identity publicly? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK006 Is retention or deletion of a user's submissions defined when the account is deleted? [Gap]

## Price Derivation Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is the tie-break defined when a baseline and an override share the same observed date? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK008 Is it defined whether a shift dated in the future applies before its effective date? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK009 Is it defined whether a shifted current price may leave the 20.00 to 200.00 range? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, FR-013]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "observed date" defined as a date or a date and time? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]

## Approval Flow

- [ ] CHK011 Is the outcome defined when an approved new-station submission duplicates a station created meanwhile? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-007, FR-018]
- [ ] CHK012 Is it defined whether an admin's own submissions also need approval and count toward the limit? [Gap, Spec §FR-016, FR-019]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by the `specify` procedure and the `clarify` procedure
